name: Secrets Manager
description: Sets, updates, or deletes an entry in the categorized secrets store used by other scripts via scripts/shared/secrets_store.py. A 'product' is the service/product the secret belongs to (gitea, paperless, finnhub, or a brand new one like Adobe) - each product should be one real product, holding one or more named keys (e.g. gitea holds both URL and TOKEN). The banner (before you click Run) shows what's already there via Secrets Viewer, so you can see existing entries and outstanding known integrations before making a change. Pick an entry from the dropdown - existing ones (green check) and known-but-unset suggestions (circle) already carry their product/key, nothing else to fill in. To create a new entry, pick "+ CREATE NEW ENTRY" and fill in New Product (pick an existing product from the list, or type a new one) and New Key (e.g. API_KEY) - both together, in the same run as Value. Running shows a themed confirmation plus the up-to-date store, so you can immediately verify the change and set the next one without leaving the page. Values are stored plaintext under /app/data/secrets.json (chmod 600, same risk tier as a Docker environment block) and are never echoed back in that store view - only a character count confirms what was set. The Value field itself is intentionally plain text, not masked: it does NOT get redacted from Script-Server's own execution history the way a secure field would, so anyone with access to view past runs of this script could see a value you typed here - accepted for readability in a home-lab, trusted-network setup, but worth knowing.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: Pick one - this alone is enough for existing/suggested entries, no other field needed

parameters.name: new_product
parameters.description: ONLY used when Entry above is "+ CREATE NEW ENTRY". Pick an existing product from the list, or type a new one (e.g. Adobe). Leave blank otherwise.

parameters.name: new_key
parameters.description: ONLY used when Entry above is "+ CREATE NEW ENTRY". The secret's name within that product, e.g. API_KEY, TOKEN, URL. Leave blank otherwise.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: New value (only used when action = Set / Update value). Plain text on purpose, so you can proofread it - see the runner description for the trade-off.
